name: Dirtywave M8 Tracker Model:02

channel.note: MIDI Settings view: a channel per track 1..8 (default track n = channel n), stored in the song; separate record, control-map (10) and song-row-cue (11) channels.

programChange.note: With PG CHANGE on, a PC on a track's channel selects that track's instrument INST 00..7F (hex). PC 0 = INST 00 is the natural reading; unverified. Bank select on receive is not documented.

controllers.name: No fixed CC list: per-song MIDI mappings (any CC on the control-map channel to instrument / mixer / effect / tempo / transpose parameters); CC 64 sustain on track input

setup: MIDI Settings: track channels (default track n = channel n).
Name the instruments in the song; the rig profile can name INST 00..7F for the editor.
notes: Instruments are per-song user content (00..7F hex); no factory names.
Firmware 6.6.3C at research time; manual v6.5.2.

sources.title: M8 firmware changelog
sources.detail: 2.5.0 sustain, 2.7.0 bank MSB on send, 2.7.3 and 6.5.2 program change
